[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 21:13  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of grilling burgers this weekend and wants to try out a new topping.  
[PREFERENCE] User has found that cheddar cheese goes well with bacon on a burger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agrees that cheddar and bacon is a classic and delicious choice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests unique topping ideas for burgers:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Caramelized Onions: Adds depth of flavor and sweetness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Mushroom Duxelles: Sautéed mushrooms with herbs and spices for an earthy flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Grilled Pineapple: Sweet and savory pairing with the smokiness of a burger.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Roasted Jalapeños: Adds a spicy kick.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Fried Egg: Adds creaminess and richness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Kimchi: Adds a bold flavor profile.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Guacamole: Adds a creamy texture and flavor boost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Grilled Bell Peppers: Adds color and flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Balsamic Glaze: Sweet and tangy balance to savory flavors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Fried Green Tomatoes: Adds crunch and tangy flavor.  
[PREFERENCE] User is intrigued by the mushroom duxelles idea and asks for more information on how to make it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides a recipe for Mushroom Duxelles, including ingredients and instructions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients: 1 cup mixed mushrooms, 2 tablespoons butter, 1 small onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup dry white wine (optional), salt and pepper, fresh thyme or parsley (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean and slice mushrooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sauté onions and garlic in butter until translucent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Add mushrooms and cook until browned.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Sprinkle flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Add wine (if using) and reduce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Season and simmer for 10-15 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT
